title: Bongo Drum-Off 808
style: latin rap-rock crossover, 104 BPM, drum-off showcase, heavy 808 sub-bass, live kit pocket, bongo percussion, distorted electric guitar, crowd chant hook, rap lead verse, three-part vocals, call and response hook, plate reverb, parallel compression, wide stereo mix, punchy kick, halftime bounce, protest anthem, absurdist wit drum-off showcase, heavy 808, live kit pocket, latin rap-rock crossover, 3 singers, rap lead verse, call-and-response hook, 104 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro - Drum Count + 808 Rise]
(4 count)
Bongo on the kit
808 in the floor
SongPal live
[Verse 1 - Corey]
We came for rhythm, no fake display
Build it from the ground in a real-time way
Bongo sets pocket, room turns wide
When that kick hits, everybody aligns
[Verse 2 - Michelle]
Voices in the air, we hold the line
Melody and motion locked in time
Three singers, one pulse, one stage light
Drums and 808 carry the night
[Verse 3 - Rafa (Rap Lead)]
Rafa en el centro, barra real
Bombo y caja pegan brutal
Sin copia, sin teatro, puro son
Bongo manda el ritmo, yo mando el flow
Corey y Michelle sostienen la voz
Zynrose al fondo, sube la tensión
[Pre-Chorus]
Kick on the one, snare on the two
Hi-hat cuts clean and the crowd breaks through
Bongo in command, that pocket don’t crack
808 pressure, no turning back
[Chorus]
Bongo drum-off, 808
Three singers on stage and the room vibrates
Corey, Michelle, Rafa in flight
Bongo on the kit takes us all night
Bongo drum-off, 808
Live and direct, no second take
[Drum-Off Section - 8 bars]
(let Bongo speak)
(toms, snare rolls, kick pattern switch)
(808 drop under the break)
[Bridge - Call and Response]
Lead: "Who drives the beat?"
Band: "Bongo!"
Lead: "Who drives the bars?"
Band: "Rafa!"
Lead: "Who holds the song?"
Band: "Corey, Michelle!"
Lead: "What’s the signal?"
Band: "Zynrose!"
[Final Chorus]
Bongo drum-off, 808
Three singers on stage and the room vibrates
Corey, Michelle, Rafa in flight
Bongo on the kit takes us all night
Bongo drum-off, 808
Family on stage, we escalate
[Outro]
Bongo.
808.
SongPal live.
